# 3way

> Two stay. One does not remember you in the morning.

A structured mini-harness: three seats (driver, coder, critic). Coder continues in tmux or screen. Critic is a fresh CLI process. Driver is a human or agent that does not implement. Independence is memory policy, not vendor.

## Docs

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahoward/3way/main/skill/SKILL.md)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahoward/3way/main/README.md)
- [Site](https://ahoward.github.io/3way/)

## Install (counted)

```
curl -fsSL https://github.com/ahoward/3way/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

GitHub release asset downloads are the install counter.

## Defaults

- mux: tmux (or screen)
- coder: continue, model fable else opus
- critic: fresh, model opus, `claude -p --no-session-persistence`
- verdicts: AGREE | DISAGREE EVIDENCE: file:line | DISAGREE CONCERN: why
